title: French Bulldog History: From the Streets of Paris to America's No. 1 Breed
description: French Bulldog history from the official breed standard: 1880s Paris, the first club, the 1898 standard, the bat ear and the rise to AKC's most popular breed.
secondaryKeywords: where do french bulldogs come from
when were french bulldogs first bred

faq.q: Where do French Bulldogs come from?
faq.a: France. The FCI breed standard lists France as the country of origin and says the modern breed came from crossings made by breeders in the working-class neighborhoods of Paris in the 1880s.

faq.q: When was the French Bulldog recognized?
faq.a: According to the FCI, the first breed club was founded in Paris in 1880 and the French Kennel Club recognized the breed in 1898, the year of the first standard.

faq.q: Are French Bulldogs related to English Bulldogs?
faq.a: The FCI standard names the Bulldog of Great Britain as a relative, along with the medieval Alaunts and the French mastiffs.

faq.q: Is the French Bulldog the most popular breed in the US?
faq.a: Yes. The American Kennel Club ranked it No. 1 in 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025.
